name: Forgot password — sign-in link submits a reset request and shows the check-email state
description: From the Production sign-in page, Forgot password opens the reset form; submitting an email shows the same check-email confirmation without revealing whether the account exists.

planSteps.description: Click the Forgot password link on the email sign-in form
Enter you@example.com in the Email field and submit Send reset link
The auth card heading Check your email. is visible above a full-width Back to sign in control, and the page does not show whether that address has an account
